note: Cypress Hills Provincial Park campground on Ferguson Hill Road just south of the Elkwater townsite, in open pine forest. Hand-pump water is not potable; drinking water, flush toilets and showers are at the Lakeview Shower House in Elkwater, open year-round. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Apr 24, 2026) and shop: 50 unserviced sites at C$28, season May 13 - Sep 6 (manual, unchanged), reservable 90 days out, vault toilets, non-potable pump. Added max_rig_ft 30 (shop). Not waterfront confirmed. Note cleaned.
flags: SEASON: page 'Season: May 13 - Sep 6' matches the stored manual season. The shop's park page shows only 'Status: Open year round' for Cypress Hills as a whole (other campgrounds stay open); no per-campground 'Closed through' line was served.
SITES: page and description say 50; the shop lists 49 (01-49). Wrote 50 from the page.
FIT: 38 sites 30 ft, one 29 ft, ten 20 ft (03, 05, 11, 14, 16, 18, 21, 39, 46, 49). A 23-ft rig fits the 30-ft sites.
PHONE: stored 403-893-3833 = the page's 'Information: 403-893-3833 EXT: 5' (Google Maps lists +1 403-893-3833; Google 4.4 from 69 reviews). No Facility Operator line.

SENIORS LINE: PRESENT on this page ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.') - this contradicts the p3-383 Alberta notes, which said the Elkwater campground pages carry none; it is on all four Cypress Hills pages in this batch.

ADVISORY: Sep 2, 2026 advisory 'Operational Service Change - Seasonal Water Shut Off': water, flush toilets and showers not guaranteed Sep 14, 2026 - Jun 1, 2027; the Lakeview Shower House stays open year-round.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed; Elkwater Lake is about 1 km north past the townsite (Elkwater townsite map).

PIN (49.65210,-110.29480): ~145 m SSE of the Alberta Parks directions point and Google's place point (49.65334,-110.29394), beside Ferguson Hill Road. The 2024 imagery shows continuous pine canopy and no visible loop here (the Elkwater townsite map draws the loop east of Ferguson Hill Road), so no move proposed; if moved, use the agency/Google point 49.65334,-110.29394.
